dataset_title: Vitrimer Thermomechanical Properties and Network Relaxation Kinetics Dataset

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Stable unique identifier for one vitrimer formulation or characterization record.

fields.name: polymer_name
fields.description: Descriptive or chemical name of the network as given in the literature.
fields.normalization_rule: Preserve original text representation; group by dynamic chemistry if generic.

fields.name: monomer_components_smiles
fields.description: Dot-separated canonical SMILES representing all raw monomer and crosslinker components forming the network matrix.
fields.normalization_rule: Standardize components individually via RDKit, sort alphabetically, and concatenate with dots.

fields.name: dynamic_link_type
fields.description: The predominant type of exchangeable dynamic covalent bond governing the network architecture.

fields.name: catalyst_name
fields.description: Chemical name or abbreviation of the catalyst driving the exchange reaction. Use 'none' for catalyst-free systems.

fields.name: catalyst_loading_mol_pct
fields.description: Molar concentration of the catalyst relative to the functional exchange groups, in mol%. Equal to 0 if catalyst_name is 'none'.

fields.name: tg_value_c
fields.description: Glass transition temperature standardized to Celsius (°C) via pipeline normalization routines.

fields.name: relaxation_time_s
fields.description: Characteristic network stress relaxation time (tau*, usually at 37% or 1/e of initial modulus) in seconds.

fields.name: relaxation_temp_c
fields.description: The specific isothermal temperature condition in Celsius (°C) under which the relaxation_time_s was determined.

fields.name: activation_energy_kj_mol
fields.description: Arrhenius activation energy (Ea) calculated from high-temperature stress relaxation or rheological rate measurements.

fields.name: tg_measurement_method
fields.description: Experimental technique used to determine the glass transition temperature (Tg).

fields.name: relaxation_measurement_method
fields.description: Experimental technique used for stress relaxation testing to extract tau and Ea. Required if relaxation_time_s is present.

fields.name: recycling_cycles
fields.description: The mechanical processing history iteration count. 0 signifies a pristine/as-cured sample; >=1 tracks structural state after extrusion/molding.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Identifier linking this row to an authoritative record within specs/source_map.json.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Broad category provenance of the host data point.

fields.name: doi
fields.description: Digital Object Identifier mapping back to source publication payload.

fields.name: conflict_flag
fields.description: Validation flag set to true if another distinct source reports anomalous deviations in kinetic profiles for the identical formulation signature.

fields.name: extraction_method
fields.description: Technical lineage pipeline execution pathway used to ingest this target point.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Granular programmatic context or sample configuration markers (e.g., crosslinking density, stoichiometry deviations).
fields.example: Ea calculated using standard Arrhenius fit between 130 and 180 °C from SI Figure S4.
